verdict.rationale: Check documents an official Postman collection covering companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls. That is a machine-readable, importable API description, a loose equivalent of a spec. Its llms.txt calls itself the "API specification" but is a markdown index, not a formal schema. missing for 10: an explicitly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file, evidence that the Postman collection covers the full API surface, independent corroboration.
